content.text:
I submitted index 12 (Al 0.39 / Sb 0.61) as the best composition. The whole library looks close to inactive at 2.1 eV, so I can't claim idx 12 is a real peak. I spent all 3 merit measurements; I only measured 3 of the 21 compositions.

| Index | Al / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 0.11 / 0.89 | 0.00063 |
| **12** | **0.39 / 0.61** | **0.00117** |
| 10 | 0.51 / 0.49 | −0.00121 (no response) |

- **How I chose:** MEGNet predicted that only a few phases have band gaps below the 2.1 eV light: Sb₂O₄ (1.67 eV), Sb₆O₁₃ (2.05 eV) and Al₂Sb₂O₇ (1.04 eV). So I started at the Sb-rich end and then moved toward the middle. MACE puts AlSbO₄ on the convex hull (stable), but MEGNet gives it a 3.65 eV gap, too wide to absorb at 2.1 eV.
- **Predictions vs. results:** the gap predictions didn't match what I measured. The Sb-rich end and idx 10 (near 50:50, where Al₂Sb₂O₇ would be) both came in below idx 12.
- **XRD:** I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans. None of the Sb-oxide reference patterns matched idx 20 well (similarity 0.18 or lower), so I couldn't confirm which phases the films contain.
